combo.description: Surprise a target by charging E, then Flashing forward to use R. AA Q and W to finish.
To all in from close range use Q R E and W in quick succession.
You can pre-6 trade by using E then W. Follow up with a Q.
Trade while dodging damage by using E then Q, followed by W.
For your standard trade, E then Q.
Oneshot a target lategame by using E then R. Q and AA, then finish off with your W.
